atoms.b: Deforestation is when lots of trees are ((++cut_down planted)).
Why is deforestation bad for the environment?
Deforestation adds to climate change and decreases ((++biodiversity sea_levels)).
Biodiversity is the variety of plant and animal life in a certain area. A ((++high low)) level of biodiversity is good.

instruction.text: Correctly order the steps to show how deforestation causes climate change.

atoms.text: Trees that store carbon dioxide are cut down.
Carbon dioxide is released back into the atmosphere as the trees decompose or are burned.
More carbon dioxide in the atmosphere means higher temperatures.

instruction.text: Correctly order the steps to show how deforestation decreases biodiversity.

hint.text: Biodiversity is the number of plants and animals that exist in a certain area.

atoms.text: Trees which are home to many species are cut down.
Animals can no longer live in their habitat.
